% An amsart document beside the list of figures, list of tables, and .aux
% of an earlier build that loaded babel and biblatex and had no figures
% or tables: the list of figures holds only babel's \babel@toc line, and
% the list of tables only biblatex's \defcounter line. This document
% loads etoolbox, which defines \defcounter, and neither babel nor
% biblatex. amsart's \@starttoc reads every list. The stale files stay as
% they are.
\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\begin{document}
\listoffigures
\listoftables
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\end{document}
